description: `npmrc`: npm 12 defaults `allow-remote=none` and its `--package-lock-only` path wrongly classifies registry tarballs of packages that declare `bundleDependencies` (here `@tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi`, pulled in by Tailwind CSS v4) as `remote`, failing lockfile updates with EALLOWREMOTE. Restores the pre-npm-12 behaviour for Renovate only. Remove once https://github.com/npm/cli/issues/9800 is fixed.
